lessons_used: Evidence is still thin for adoption redesigns, as only one test has been completed so far.
Evidence is still thin for home new screens, as only one test has been completed so far.
Evidence is still thin for finish redesigns, as only one test has been completed so far.
No clear effect has been seen for adoption new screens across 2 completed tests.
Predictions have been consistently too high compared to noise-corrected measured results.

candidates.title: Story Intro Carousel Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the story screen into an interactive carousel layout highlighting different pet personalities before path selection.
candidates.why: choose_path step has a high mean duration of 514s and 23.8% drop-off; a carousel layout engages users early.

story.headline: Welcome to Your Desktop Companion World
story.body: Swipe to explore how your pet stays by your side while you work, relax, or study.

guard.reason: Redesigning the story screen into an interactive carousel is allowed within onboarding as long as it introduces the pet.

candidates.score_note: Addresses high step duration, but lack of support mail and high cost lower priority.

candidates.title: Pet Personality Quiz Screen
candidates.change: Insert a short personality quiz screen before pick_friend to guide users toward their ideal companion choice.
candidates.why: Adoption has a 33.8% drop-off rate and a high median time of 89s; guiding preference selection improves decision speed and fit.

new_personality_quiz.headline: Find Your Ideal Companion
new_personality_quiz.body: Answer a few questions so we can match you with the pet personality that fits your day.

guard.reason: Adding a personality quiz sub-flow inside onboarding without skipping any required steps is allowed.

candidates.score_note: High drop-off step, but adoption new screens have shown no positive effect (-1.1% historical).

candidates.title: Sign In After Photo Upload Reorder
candidates.change: Move sign_in to occur after photo upload, right before the adoption certificate is finalized.
candidates.why: Sign-in drop-off is 27.1%; deferring sign-in until after pet customization builds ownership and increases completion.

guard.reason: Reordering sign-in to appear after photo upload is explicitly permitted by Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Reordering sign-in reduces friction, though evidence is based solely on funnel drop-off.

candidates.title: Home Intro Spotlight Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign home_intro with a spotlight layout highlighting key desktop control locations and shortcuts.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets reported confusion on how to control or hide pets, and finish step completion is only 64.8%.

home_intro.headline: Your Desktop Companion is Ready!
home_intro.body: See how to interact, hide, or talk to your pet anytime from your screen.

guard.reason: Redesigning the home intro overlay is permitted as home_intro is part of onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Strong evidence from tickets and drop-off, but finish redesigns previously performed poorly (-4.0%).

candidates.title: Account Persistence Sign In Hint
candidates.change: Add an explicit hint on the sign-in screen assuring users that logging in restores their existing pets and data.
candidates.why: Support received 8 emails regarding missing or reset pets after signing in again.

sign_in.hint: Signing into your registered account automatically recovers your existing pets and preferences.

guard.reason: Adding a helpful sign-in persistence hint is allowed and does not violate any rules.

candidates.score_note: High evidence from 8 support emails, simple low-cost copy change with high probability of success.

candidates.title: Desktop Visibility Status Info
candidates.change: Display real-time desktop overlay status indicators and system tray instructions during the waiting screen.
candidates.why: Support received 3 bug reports about pets failing to display on desktop, and home mean time is 2336s.

waiting.hint: Initializing desktop overlay. If your pet isn't visible on completion, check your system tray icon.

guard.reason: Adding technical overlay setup details to the waiting screen preserves its function and rules.

candidates.score_note: Targeted status info helps with desktop visibility bugs at low implementation cost.

candidates.title: Pick Friend Two Column Layout
candidates.change: Reformat the pick_friend screen layout to a two-column grid separating standard presets from custom photo generation.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets cited custom pet creation confusion/failures, and adoption has a 33.8% drop-off.

pick_friend.headline: Select a Preset Pet or Create Your Own

guard.reason: Redesigning the pick_friend layout while preserving its selection function is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Addresses major adoption drop-off and support confusion, though redesign evidence remains thin.

candidates.title: First Day Treat Pack Incentive
candidates.change: Display a starter treat reward badge on the final completion screen upon completing onboarding.
candidates.why: Overall onboarding completion is low at 19.4%; adding an immediate completion reward boosts final drop-off recovery.

components.label: Reward Unlocked: Starter Accessory & Treat Pack

guard.reason: 'home_intro.components[0].label' must be text up to 40 characters

candidates.title: Photo Upload Lighting Guidance Hint
candidates.change: Add a visual photo quality hint explaining clear lighting and background rules for custom pet generation.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failures or distorted results.

upload_photos.hint: Use well-lit photos with clear subject outlines for accurate custom pet creation.

guard.reason: Adding helpful visual photo upload quality guidance is allowed within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Cheap visual hint directly targeting 3 support emails on photo upload failures in high drop-off step.

candidates.title: Desktop Overlay Permission Flow
candidates.change: Add a new setup step in home to guide users through desktop overlay and system tray permissions.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets noted pets not appearing on desktop and 4 noted post-onboarding feature misbehavior.

new_desktop_permissions.headline: Configure Desktop Display Permissions
new_desktop_permissions.body: Allow system tray access so your desktop pet can move freely across your screens.

guard.reason: screen 'new_desktop_permissions' is not part of onboarding (new screens are named new_..., and may not look like payment, account, sign-up or settings screens)
